mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to expected equity cash flows, increasing the present value of future dividends and earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises the cost of capital, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer and business confidence and compressing earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 indicates weak manufacturing activity, compressing earnings expectations and reducing investor optimism, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in weak periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 1,200 units signals strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and investor optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in retail sales (HOUST) below 1,000 units signals weak consumer demand, compressing earnings expectations and reducing investor optimism, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weak demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
